label: Replication
text: BI.O.A1.1 Replication. Template copying of DNA, or RNA in some viruses, with stated fidelity. Copying fidelity as heredity is owned here. The template chemistry and base-pair energetics are owned by CH.O.A3 (uses CH.O.A3).

warrant.standard: Replicated cross or edit; sequencing with stated error rate; independent lab confirmation
warrant.defeaters: Contamination; off-target edits; annotation error; linkage mistaken for causation
